title: Business days
skill: State the edge cases the agent cannot guess

good: Rewrite add_business_days(start, n, holidays) in workdays.py. A business day is Monday to Friday and not in holidays. Step one calendar day at a time; the start day never counts. n > 0 goes forward n business days. n < 0 goes back abs(n) business days. From a non-business day count as usual: Saturday + 1 is Monday, Sunday - 1 is Friday. n == 0 returns start if it is a business day, else the next business day after it. Only change workdays.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Fix add_business_days so it works for all cases.
